name: bench2agent
description: Ask which evaluation benchmarks researchers use, how use changes, and which new benchmarks are adopted.

commands.title: Bench2Agent: Sign In with Claude Code

bench2agent.installPath.description: Bench2Agent checkout or install directory. Leave empty to use the current workspace when ready, then ~/.bench2agent.

bench2agent.pythonPath.description: Python 3.10+ executable. Leave empty to use the install's serving venv, then python3 (python on Windows).

bench2agent.extraPath.description: Optional executable directory for the Codex or Claude CLI when VS Code's extension host cannot find it.

bench2agent.useMeilisearch.description: Start the installed Meilisearch engine when available.
